_comment: Project: Li'l Vera Cycle 1, Stage N.3.0 — hand-encoded Sugar Maple
(Acer saccharum) species-conditioned spatial priors. Hand-encoded by
Penzias from forestry references (Hallé & Oldeman 1970 Rauh's-model
architecture; USDA NRCS plant guide; published DBH-height-age
relationships for northeastern hardwoods). Cycle 2+ statistical
aggregation refines these values from real LiDAR specimens.
Interpretation: every key/value here is a load-bearing INPUT to the
growth (Phase 3b, N.3.2+). The likelihood function in priors.likelihood
consumes (heightFrac, radialDist, inferredRadius, localAxis) and emits
file specification for the full formula.
Naming convention note (intentional drift): `dbhRange` keeps the
forestry-conventional 'DBH' (Diameter at Breast Height) field name for
grep-ability with USDA/FIA datasets, but VALUES are TRUNK RADIUS (not
diameter) to be consistent with every other r-suffixed field in this
schema. Botanically-literate readers: yes, this is intentional.

expectedRadiusByPosition._comment: Position-dependent expected trunk/branch radius envelope. Looked up via scipy.interpolate.LinearNDInterpolator on (heightFrac, radialDist) → {rMin, rMax, rMode}, with NearestNDInterpolator fallback for off-hull queries (load-bearing — see brief). Values are TRUNK / BRANCH RADIUS in meters at that tree-frame position.

branchAngleDistribution._comment: Sugar Maple Rauh's-model strong-leader topology. Scaffolds emerge between 25-75° from vertical with a modal ~50°. Never near-horizontal (≥85° is in hardRejections).

expectedLocalDirection._comment: Position-dependent expected branch tangent. Consumed by Phase 3b axonal growth (N.3.2+) to steer prior_direction at each probe step. Reconstruction: polar θ from this table; azimuthal radial-outward direction from probe-position vs trunk-axis (well-defined unless probe is within axialFallbackRadius of the axis, in which case prior collapses to vertical steer + inherits azimuth from current_direction). See brief §Species priors file specification.

branchingDensityByHeight._comment: Expected branches-per-meter as a function of heightFrac. Linear-interp between samples. Below junctionMinBranchingDensity, junction classifications are zeroed (no junction possible where the species has no branching at this height).

expectedTipRadius._comment: Tip-class-specific radius envelope. A branch terminus is by definition thin (Sugar Maple twig diameters ~2-12mm). Used in priors.likelihood when geometric_class == 'tip' to reject thick trunk-base spurs that pass the position-conditioned envelope but aren't biologically tips.

expectedTipHeightFrac._comment: Tips live in the upper-canopy region of the tree, not at the trunk base. Soft prior: Sugar Maple terminal twigs concentrate in the upper ~50% of the tree.

hardRejections._comment: Hard impossibilities — likelihood snaps to 0 regardless of other channels. Soft priors (down-weights) are handled by the gaussian-bell smoothness in priors.likelihood; hard rejections are reserved for things botanically impossible.
